cases.title: Case 1: ENSO Rainfall Seesaw
cases.mechanism_teaser: Pacific Walker Circulation shifts drive inverse rainfall anomalies between coastal Peru and Maritime Continent Indonesia.

cases.title: Case 2: North American Hydrological Dipole
cases.mechanism_teaser: Subtropical dry-belt expansion desiccates the Southwest while shifting storm tracks wet the Upper Midwest.

cases.title: Case 3: Polar Amplification vs Atlantic Cold Blob
cases.mechanism_teaser: Sea-ice albedo feedback drives rapid Svalbard warming (+0.8°C/dec) while subpolar Atlantic overturning resists warming.

cases.title: Case 4: Amazon Canopy Moisture Stress
cases.mechanism_teaser: Deforestation-edge moisture recycling loss dries the southeastern arc twice as fast as the intact central core.
